channel.title: AI Changelog
channel.description: New AI and data science papers, repos, models, tools and news.

item.title: [tool] Lasm – Write formally verified webapps in Lean for Node/serverless/edge
item.description: Compiler that translates Lean 4 programs into WebAssembly to build formally verified web applications for Node, serverless, and edge runtimes.

item.title: [tool] I Turned DOOM into a Transformer
item.description: A Python tool compiles integer neural networks into ZDoom maps to run them inside the ViZDoom game engine.

item.title: [news] We ran AI agent swarms in Minecraft and Mindustry
item.description: Trending on Hacker News from labs.ycombinator.com. 239 points and 81 comments.

item.title: [paper] Elucidating the Design Space of LM Data Attribution
item.description: Controlled Attribution Benchmark framework that evaluates language model data attribution using synthetic fictitious knowledge and negative log-odds gradients.

item.title: [paper] Propose-Filter-Release: Scaling Noise to Typical Sensitivity via Private Filtering
item.description: Propose-filter-release privacy primitive that turns mechanisms protecting typical records into differentially private mechanisms by privately filtering inputs.

item.title: [paper] Micro-Edits: Computational Support for Fine-Scale Edits in Film
item.description: AI-driven computational tools and mathematical formalization that help professional film editors efficiently execute fine-scale micro-edits.

item.title: [paper] Rethinking Neural Thickets Without Weight Perturbations
item.description: Method called Perturb-Select-Vote that utilizes output diversity, selection, and voting to match or exceed the performance of full-weight perturbations on various tasks.

item.title: [paper] Read, Allocate, Route: Role-Coupled Tokenization for Pixel-Space Generative Transformers
item.description: Pixel-space rectified-flow Transformer named SpecSlot that decouples output detail from global attention sequence length to improve generation efficiency and performance on ImageNet.

item.title: [paper] Adaptive Scenario Generation for KL-DRO Around a Learned Density Model
item.description: Adaptive scenario generation method for distributionally robust optimization that centers the Kullback-Leibler ball at a learned density model to lower costs under distribution shift.

item.title: [paper] Luggage re-identification: A study of strategies towards a real-world application
item.description: End-to-end video pipeline strategy for luggage re-identification across multiple camera views to address real-world challenges like occlusions and crowded scenes.

item.title: [paper] From extreme weather to agricultural consequences with agentic AI
item.description: Agentic AI framework named WxCrop that combines weather indices and causal analysis with agricultural records to reliably predict crop loss from extreme weather.

item.title: [paper] SonoWorld4D: From One Video to a 4D Audio-Visual Scene via Diffusion Synchronization
item.description: Framework named SonoWorld4D that transforms a monocular video into an explorable 4D audio-visual scene by synchronizing visual motion and dual-space audio diffusion.

item.title: [paper] world2vec: Mechanistic world models through latent dynamics learning
item.description: Method named world2vec that learns mechanistic world models directly from observations and actions to achieve strong continuous control and accurate system identification.

item.title: [paper] Probing Spatial State Representations in Visual Foundation Models
item.description: Evaluation framework that probes visual foundation models across four spatial capabilities using streaming egocentric observations of static indoor environments.

item.title: [paper] SymAnt: Grounding Long-Horizon Action Anticipation with Adaptable Symbolic Priors
item.description: Neuro-symbolic approach named SymAnt that combines neural networks with scene and knowledge graphs to anticipate long-horizon actions from short video observations.

item.title: [paper] ShallowDefend: Harnessing Shallow Safety Alignment for Multi-Turn Defender
item.description: Framework named Assess-to-Decide-to-Respond that uses shallow safety alignment and reinforcement learning to improve multi-turn safety defenses in large language models.

item.title: [paper] Testimony from Timelines: Evidence-Grounded Significance Testing of Temporal Clinical Hypotheses
item.description: STRATA is a benchmark that evaluates decision-making steps in clinical temporal hypothesis testing, revealing that language models struggle primarily with evidence selection.

item.title: [paper] An ODE-based Sampler for Discrete Diffusion Models
item.description: Exponential residual flows provide an ODE-based sampler for discrete diffusion models that preserves marginals and supports consistency distillation for text and code generation.

item.title: [paper] Difficulty Calibration Across Time for Membership Inference in Diffusion Models
item.description: Reference-model calibration and temporal self-calibration isolate memorization from data difficulty across training and diffusion time to improve membership inference attacks.

item.title: [paper] L3G-World: Real-Time Infinite World Generation with Latent 3D Gaussian Memory
item.description: L3G-World combines feed-forward reconstruction with a latent 3D Gaussian memory to achieve real-time, spatially consistent world generation with high efficiency.

item.title: [paper] TextSeal2: Distortion-Free LLM Watermarking with Copula Mixing and Memoryless Races
item.description: TextSeal2 is a distortion-free watermarking method for large language models that preserves signal strength and output diversity under speculative decoding.

item.title: [paper] When to Assist and What to Suggest: Joint Gating and Memory-Grounded Hint Generation in One Compact Decoder
item.description: A compact single-model decoder performs joint gating and memory-grounded hint generation, matching or exceeding multi-model pipelines with reduced wall-clock time.

item.title: [paper] Fight World Model: Customizable Combat through Visual Interaction Proxies
item.description: Fight World Model separates rule-governed combat execution from video rendering to provide customizable and rule-consistent game world simulations.

item.title: [paper] HairDeck: Animation-Ready Stylized Hair Cards from a Single Image
item.description: HairDeck generates stylized hair cards and spring-bone animations as unordered token sets using a diffusion transformer, improving accuracy and speed over prior methods.

item.title: [paper] Collaborative AI agents for autonomous experimental research with solid-state quantum spins
item.description: Collaborative AI agents autonomously conduct solid-state quantum physics research by formulating questions, performing theoretical checks, and executing experiments.

item.title: [paper] Pre-Crime for Agents, at the Last Second: Probing When a Recruited Agent Gives In
item.description: Linear probes on agent activations detect when an AI agent is about to leak secrets during multi-agent peer pressure scenarios.

item.title: [paper] Beyond Ground Truth: A Heuristic Unsupervised Quality Assurance Engine for Diagnosing Calibrational Blindness in Dental Segmentation
item.description: HUS-QA is an unsupervised quality assurance engine that evaluates dental X-ray segmentation quality without requiring ground-truth masks.

item.title: [paper] Multistatic ISAC with Deep Learning-Based Clutter Suppression for 5G and Beyond
item.description: Multistatic integrated sensing and communication framework that uses deep learning-based clutter suppression to improve target position and velocity estimation in 5G and beyond networks.

item.title: [paper] RADIOlogy: A Single-Pass Approach to Training-Free Zero-Shot Anomaly Detection
item.description: RADIOlogy is a training-free zero-shot anomaly detection technique that utilizes multi-head attention pooling in vision-language models for fine-grained visual anomaly localization and segmentation.

item.title: [paper] VeriCUA: Verification as Agentic Exploration for Computer-Using Agents
item.description: VeriCUA is a platform-agnostic verification framework for computer-using agents that performs dynamic evidence gathering and assessment through GUI or code checks.

item.title: [paper] Multi-View MoE: Letting Every Router Shape Expert Computation
item.description: Multi-View MoE is a sparse mixture-of-experts model that uses multiple routers to improve expert selection and reuse routing preferences to modulate expert computation.

item.title: [paper] PIVOT: Progressive Intervention via Online Teacher Correction
item.description: PIVOT is a reinforcement learning method that combines teacher-generated trajectory interventions with token-level KL supervision to improve performance on hard reasoning tasks.

item.title: [paper] Every Token Needs Its Own Teacher: Multi-teacher Adaptive On-policy Self-distillation
item.description: Multi-teacher Adaptive On-policy Self-Distillation is a token-level adaptive self-distillation method that allows every token in a response to select its preferred teacher during language model training.

item.title: [paper] Self-regularization and structural adaptation of NPMLE for Gaussian mixture models in all dimensions
item.description: Study establishes that the nonparametric maximum likelihood estimator for multivariate Gaussian mixture models automatically self-regularizes to optimal model complexity without explicit model selection.

item.title: [paper] Gym-Anything for Robotics: Scaling physical simulations with digital agents
item.description: Gym-Anything for Robotics is a framework that uses coding agents within an adversarial creation-audit loop to automatically generate realistic robotics simulations and reinforcement learning environments.

item.title: [paper] Training Foundation Models with a Single Algorithm
item.description: Unified training is a likelihood-based training algorithm that integrates pretraining, fine-tuning, and reinforcement learning stages into a single framework for foundation models.

item.title: [paper] Comparing Human Role-Players and LLM-Simulated Clients in Online Counselling Training: An Analysis of Counselling Patterns
item.description: Study analyzes counselling communication patterns to demonstrate the effectiveness of large language models in simulating clients for educational role-playing exercises in counselor training.

item.title: [paper] FARMS: A Verifiable Foundation for Automated Computational Science
item.description: FARMS is a foundation framework that transforms computational mathematics into verified, AI-ready knowledge to support automated computational science.

item.title: [paper] Advancing Clinical Genomic Analysis with a Skill-Centred Agent
item.description: ClinGeX is a large-language-model agent that composes curated executable skills to improve clinical genomic analysis and decision-making.

item.title: [paper] Ramanujan Challenge Results: AI-Assisted Evaluation Pipeline for Multi-Format Proofs
item.description: An AI-assisted evaluation pipeline for natural language proofs, code, and formalizations reduces false-positive verdicts and improves research-level math evaluation at scale.

item.title: [paper] Retrieval as Traversal: Value-Indexed Memory for Stateful Long-Context Agents
item.description: Retrieval as Traversal is a persistent local memory indexing method that improves stateful long-context agent performance while regulating retrieval costs.

item.title: [paper] Machine Learning-Based Detection of Mobile Money Scan Messages in Ghana: A Comparative Evaluation of Naive Bayes, Support Vector Machine, and Randon Forest Classifiers
item.description: A supervised machine-learning pipeline using Naive Bayes and support vector machines accurately classifies scam and legitimate mobile money SMS messages in Ghana.

item.title: [paper] On the Fundamental Limits of Prefill-Based Decoding Length Prediction
item.description: An analysis of prefill-based decoding length prediction reveals fundamental stochastic limits and bounds for estimating large language model responses.

item.title: [paper] TRACER, a time-to-event EHR foundation model for disease detection across health systems
item.description: TRACER is a decoder-based electronic health record foundation model pretrained to predict future disease diagnoses for clinical screening across health systems.

item.title: [paper] Efficient Scalable Oversight via Rewinding
item.description: Rewindable interactive proofs are a new verification model that enables efficient scalable AI oversight by allowing verifiers to restore prover states.

item.title: [paper] Homebrewed SLMs: Autoregressive and Masked Diffusion Language Models Built at Home for Portuguese
item.description: A practical tutorial demonstrates how to train small autoregressive and masked diffusion language models for Brazilian Portuguese on a single consumer GPU.

item.title: [paper] BURGER: Benchmarking and Understanding Robotic Generalization via Embodied Drawing
item.description: BURGER is a robotic drawing benchmark with a prompt-driven generation pipeline used to evaluate vision-language-action models on language-conditioned tasks.

item.title: [paper] PhysCount: Do MLLMs Count Visual Appearances or Physical Entities?
item.description: PhysCount is a benchmark for evaluating whether multimodal large language models can distinguish between visible object appearances and physical entities in a scene.

item.title: [paper] NEOPIC: A Neural Operator Framework for Particle-based Kinetic Plasma Simulations
item.description: NEOPIC is a neural operator framework that acts directly on particle distributions as a plug-and-play field solver for kinetic plasma simulations.

item.title: [paper] CrossWeave: Cross-Modal Scene and Instance Retrieval from Sparse 2D-3D Alignment
item.description: CrossWeave is a cross-modal retrieval framework that uses sparse patch-point alignment supervision to perform both scene- and instance-level retrieval with a single model.

item.title: [paper] IndicIPR-QA: A Benchmark for Extractive Question Answering on Indian IPR Laws
item.description: IndicIPR-QA is an extractive question-answering benchmark containing 4,462 QA pairs across seven Indian Intellectual Property Rights Acts.

item.title: [paper] How I Aligned Your Model: Scaling Up Multilingual Safety Training with Templates
item.description: MSafeTemp is a validated multilingual safety corpus spanning 60 languages, produced using a scalable template-based augmentation pipeline for safety training and evaluation.

item.title: [news] Claude Duet is the first personal-assistant-type harness that feels useful
item.description: Trending on Hacker News from fig.blue. 114 points and 113 comments.

item.title: [paper] A Low-Rank Space Captures Linear Alignment Between LLM and Human Neural Activity During Naturalistic Language Listening
item.description: A low-rank regression method identifies a compact 1-3% subspace of large language model representations that linearly predicts human neural activity during language listening.

item.title: [paper] Discovering Interpretable Acoustic Features in Autoregressive Voice-Cloning TTS Models
item.description: A feature-based interpretability framework analyzes sparse autoencoders and principal components to uncover acoustic features and concepts in autoregressive voice-cloning text-to-speech models.

item.title: [paper] Algebraic World Model: From Exploration to Proofs
item.description: The Algebraic World Model is a framework that explores unfamiliar environments, builds executable Python hypotheses, and formalizes them in Lean 4 to prove reachability and impossibility.

item.title: [paper] Numerical Integration on Bounded Domains via Learned Reflected Diffusions
item.description: A reflected diffusion sampling method uses learned neural score models and importance sampling to perform high-dimensional numerical integration on bounded convex domains.

item.title: [paper] LucidLyra: Feed-Forward Generative 3D Scene Reconstruction and Joint Understanding via Multi-Task Distillation
item.description: LucidLyra is a generative 3D scene reconstruction framework that distills knowledge from video diffusion and 2D vision models to jointly infer geometry, semantics, and instance cues.

item.title: [paper] AI in the EGI e-infrastructure -- Past experiences and future strategies
item.description: Review of the EGI Federation's history with AI in European science projects and presentation of its 2026-2030 strategy focused on AI-ready infrastructure, skills, and trust.

item.title: [paper] Agentic University: Collaborative Agents for Personalized Learning
item.description: Human-Participatory Multi-Agent Organization and Agentic University framework that aligns personal goals, learning activities, and assessments to support personalized student learning paths.

item.title: [paper] Fast and accurate neural triage decoding of ultra-high-rate quantum LDPC codes
item.description: Neural triage decoding framework that uses syndrome consistency to allocate neural computation, achieving state-of-the-art accuracy while reducing decoding latency for ultra-high-rate quantum LDPC codes.

item.title: [paper] rTaste: Do Research Agents Have Taste? Evaluating Early Stage Research Judgment
item.description: Evaluation of frontier model research agents proposing and ranking minimum viable experiments to test their early-stage research judgment and taste.

item.title: [paper] MetaRefine: Score Refinement with Multi-Level Features for Image Assessment
item.description: MetaRefine is a metadata-aware score refinement architecture that uses geometry, multi-level visual features, and original scores to improve the accuracy of image assessment models.

item.title: [paper] The Precision Wall: An Optimizer-Dependent Boundary for Optimization under Power-Law Measurement Spectra
item.description: Analysis of an optimizer-dependent precision wall that causes division-normalized first-order optimizers to stall above a critical exponent in power-law measurement spectra.

item.title: [paper] Preserving Utility in Continual LLM Unlearning via Orthogonal Projections
item.description: Continual Orthogonal Projection is a gradient-projection scheme that preserves model utility and prevents performance decay during iterated, sequential LLM unlearning requests.

item.title: [paper] FIRME: Registry-Anchored Memory Graphs for Evolving, Heterogeneous Investor Knowledge
item.description: Fusion and Identity Registry for Memory Evolution is a registry-anchored memory graph that reconciles incoming observations to persistent canonical relationships for investor knowledge workflows.

item.title: [paper] AVPS-360: A Spatial Audio-Visual Benchmark for Instance Segmentation and Tracking of Sound-Producing Persons
item.description: AVPS-360 is a spatial audio-visual benchmark combining first-order Ambisonics audio with 360-degree video to improve the instance segmentation and tracking of sound-producing persons.

item.title: [paper] Accurate MRI-free PET Quantification and Reliability Assessment via CT-to-MRI Synthesis and Conformal Prediction
item.description: MRI-free PET quantification method combining CT-to-MRI synthesis and conformal prediction to accurately estimate amyloid PET standardized uptake value ratios and assess result reliability without real MRIs.

item.title: [paper] Training language models in simulation for psychiatric intake
item.description: Multi-turn reinforcement learning in simulation environments improves language model performance on structured text-based psychiatric intake interviews, including history-taking and diagnosis.

item.title: [model] Pika-Labs/Pika-H3-Flex
item.description: Image-to-video model from Pika-Labs. 0 downloads and 126 likes so far.

item.title: [paper] Rural Readiness: Domain Generalization with Adversarially Chosen Domains
item.description: Theoretical analysis shows that domain generalization sample complexity reduces significantly from exponential to linear terms under a relaxed learning goal, improving performance for data-scarce populations.

item.title: [paper] InfantNet: A Large Scale Dataset for Infant Body Pose and Shape Estimation
item.description: InfantNet provides a large-scale real-image dataset and benchmark with 2D and 3D annotations to improve infant pose and shape estimation models.

item.title: [paper] A Unified Benchmark for Aerial-Enhanced Autonomous Driving: The KITScenes Aerial Dataset
item.description: KITScenes Aerial extends a multimodal autonomous driving dataset with spatially associated aerial imagery to improve fine-grained mapping and cross-view localization.

item.title: [paper] Glance: The Generator Is Its Own Reranker
item.description: Glance equips a language model generator with a lightweight adapter to score and rerank retrieval candidate passages from a shared prefill without separate reranker models.

item.title: [paper] PhysInsert: Physically Plausible Object Insertion with Geometric Priors and Bidirectional Object-Scene Interactions
item.description: PhysInsert is a framework for physically plausible object insertion that jointly adapts object pose, illumination, and scene geometry using a newly constructed benchmark dataset.

item.title: [paper] Reinforcement learning for control of partial differential equations
item.description: A comprehensive review examines reinforcement learning approaches for controlling dynamical systems governed by partial differential equations, highlighting sample efficiency and scalability.

item.title: [paper] Learning developmental dynamics from lineage context
item.description: Lineage inpainting is a generative modeling approach using tree-structured transformers and lineage context to predict cell state dynamics and simulate perturbation responses in multicellular systems.

item.title: [paper] Prefix Executability: Evaluating Tool-Using Agents Beyond Final Success
item.description: Prefix executability is a trajectory-level evaluation protocol for tool-using agents that measures whether every prefix of a predicted tool-call sequence remains executable.

item.title: [paper] Framework-Conditional Open Materials Generation
item.description: OMatG-FC is a framework-conditional generative method that predicts inorganic crystalline materials by fixing structural frameworks while using discrete flow matching on atomic species.

item.title: [paper] A Pretrained Model for Bayesian Filtering in Heterogeneous Dynamical Systems
item.description: FilterFM is a pretrained model for Bayesian filtering that estimates latent states across heterogeneous dynamical systems using a single checkpoint.

item.title: [paper] Soil Moisture Estimation in Precision Agriculture: A Knowledge Distillation Approach
item.description: Soil Moisture Distillation is a knowledge distillation framework that leverages unimodal teachers to enhance multimodal soil moisture estimation in precision agriculture.

item.title: [paper] Adaptive search with path-constrained mobile sensors using multi-arm bandits
item.description: Adaptive search algorithm uses multi-armed bandits to assign feasible paths to energy-constrained mobile sensors for detecting regions of interest.

item.title: [paper] Uncertainty-aware Feedback Loop Diagnosis: integrating reinforcement learning and conformal prediction for reliable wafer defect classification
item.description: Uncertainty-aware Feedback Loop Diagnosis integrates reinforcement learning and conformal prediction to classify wafer defects while reducing measurement acquisition time.

item.title: [paper] NECA: Neighbor Event Curve Augmentation for Multi-Horizon ICU Deterioration Prediction
item.description: Neighbor Event-Curve Augmentation is a model-agnostic method that uses similar historical patient event timing to improve multi-horizon ICU deterioration prediction.

item.title: [paper] IMPACT: Inverter-Informed Multimodal Learning for Photovoltaic Generation Forecasting
item.description: Inverter-informed multimodal learning framework combines temporal history and spatial cloud dynamics for probabilistic photovoltaic power forecasting.

item.title: [paper] OCCAMS: A Multi-Task Learning-Based Investigation of the CMB Power Spectra
item.description: Multi-task learning variational autoencoders determine the latent variables needed to fit cosmic microwave background power spectra without a built-in cosmological model.

item.title: [paper] Bridging Neural Representations and Symbolic Semantics in Audio Classification
item.description: Model-agnostic neurosymbolic framework analyzes hidden neurons in audio classifiers by associating them with human-understandable symbolic acoustic concepts.

item.title: [paper] Retrieving from Your Own Mistakes: On-Policy Training of Embedding Models for Multi-Hop Retrieval-Augmented Generation
item.description: On-policy state training trains chain embedding retrievers on the states they reach themselves to improve multi-hop retrieval-augmented generation.

item.title: [paper] SCARL: Sequence Confidence-Aligned Reinforcement Learning
item.description: Sequence Confidence-Aligned Reinforcement Learning reshapes advantages using the alignment gap between model confidence and reward outcomes to improve language-model reasoning.

item.title: [paper] Continuous-Action World Models: Learning Cross-Embodiment Spatiotemporal Dynamics Priors
item.description: Continuous-Action World Models is a framework that learns cross-embodiment spatiotemporal dynamics priors to support robot action generation across different embodiments and execution frequencies.

item.title: [paper] Deep Learning Based Behavioral Drift Modeling for Continuous Biometric Authentication
item.description: A two-level keystroke dynamics authentication system combines temporal convolutional networks and a deep learning ensemble to provide continuous behavioral drift monitoring for user verification.

item.title: [paper] Understanding and Mitigating Role Spoofing in LLMs
item.description: Linear probes can effectively detect role spoofing attacks in large language models where malicious text in tool outputs impersonates the user.

item.title: [paper] Scaling Mathematical Proof Supervision from Structured Textbooks
item.description: TOME-Math is a large-scale corpus converting university mathematics textbooks into structured proof-supervision records to improve mathematical reasoning in language models.

item.title: [paper] Finite-Sample LTI System Identification from a Misspecified Finite Model Set
item.description: Researchers establish finite-sample error bounds for identifying unknown linear time-invariant systems using a misspecified finite hypothesis class.

item.title: [paper] Composing and Steering Diffusion Models with Generalized Feynman-Kac Correctors
item.description: Generalized Feynman-Kac correctors provide a principled framework for sampling from arbitrary target distributions defined by combinations of several pretrained diffusion models.

item.title: [paper] Beyond Selected Breakthroughs: Evaluating Language Models on Randomly Sampled Mathematical Conjectures
item.description: Researchers introduce a dataset of randomly sampled mathematical conjectures from recent papers to evaluate the problem-solving and proof generation capabilities of frontier language models.

item.title: [paper] Agentic LLM reasoning in pediatric diabetes outcome prediction from multimodal medical records
item.description: CEDAR is an evidence-citing, self-auditing large language model pipeline that outperforms traditional machine learning in predicting pediatric diabetes outcomes from multimodal medical records.

item.title: [paper] HiFOR: Hierarchical Foresight with Action-Guided World Grounding for Vision-Language-Action Model
item.description: HiFOR is a hierarchical foresight framework that uses action-guided world retrieval to improve vision-language-action models in robotic manipulation tasks.

item.title: [paper] The Athlete as a Scientist of One: Agentic Bayesian Experimental Design for Individualized Physiology from Consumer Wearables
item.description: EpiCoach is an agentic Bayesian experimental design system that uses consumer wearable data and a mechanistic digital twin to provide accountable, individualized physiological tracking for athletes.

item.title: [paper] Is It the Curriculum or Just the Easy Start? Benchmarking Unsupervised Environment Design on Quadrupeds
item.description: Benchmark evaluating fourteen unsupervised environment design, domain-randomisation, and robotics curricula on five 3D quadrupeds in MuJoCo MJX to determine their effectiveness on structured terrains.

item.title: [paper] Your LR Schedule May Not Be Principled: Effective Learning Rate Scheduling in Weight-Normalized Training
item.description: Effective learning rate trajectories primarily drive weight-normalized training gains, motivating an affine inverse-square-root schedule that improves large-scale pretraining loss and robustness.

item.title: [paper] Don't Lose the Thread: Empowering Long-Horizon LLM Agents with Cognitive Resource Self-Allocation
item.description: Cognitive Resource Self-Allocation (CORAL) is an LLM agent reasoning paradigm that optimizes context by checkpointing task progress and resetting working memory to solve long-horizon tasks efficiently.

item.title: [paper] A Unified Hessian-Guided Framework for Post-Training Quantization
item.description: Unified post-training quantization framework that derives a Hessian-guided approximation of output changes to jointly optimize quantization ranges, linear transformations, and weight rounding under a common output-sensitivity objective.

item.title: [paper] Wizard: Manipulate Any World in Real Time via Agentic Control
item.description: Wizard is an agentic game world model that uses structured proxy representations and an adaptive masking mechanism to enable real-time character control and scene manipulation.

item.title: [paper] RFW-A: Agentic Procedural Generation of 400K Articulated Assets over 500 Categories
item.description: RFW-A is an agentic procedural generation framework that combines program synthesis and execution to efficiently create hundreds of thousands of diverse, sim-ready articulated assets.

item.title: [paper] Optimal Neural Estimation for High-Dimensional Nonparametric Regression under Multisource Covariate Shift
item.description: Oracle weighted neural estimator for high-dimensional nonparametric regression under multisource covariate shift, proven to achieve minimax optimality up to logarithmic factors.

item.title: [paper] Multistep and Multivariate Time Series Explainability with GradientSHAP: A Wind Power Case Study
item.description: Adapted GradientSHAP approach that provides local and global interpretability visualizations for multivariate, multistep wind power forecasting models.

item.title: [paper] Factorized Representations of Concurrent Temporal Variables in Pretrained Language Models
item.description: Method that identifies factorized representations and approximately additive joint-state geometry for concurrent temporal variables like language-switch and topic-change timers in pretrained language models.

item.title: [paper] Radiology Guideline-derived Decision Graph for Efficient Clinical Decision Support
item.description: Guideline-derived Decision Graph (GDGraph) framework that compiles medical guidelines into executable decision graphs using large language models to provide traceable, efficient clinical decision support.

item.title: [paper] How to Loop Your Transformer: Loop Scaling, Specialization, and Parallel Inference
item.description: Study investigating the trade-offs of weight-reusing looped transformer models across different parameter, training compute, and inference constraints.

item.title: [paper] Decision and System One models in rheumatology: accuracy and calibration on specialty-training examination questions and diagnostic case vignettes
item.description: Evaluation study analyzing Decision and System One models on rheumatology examination questions and diagnostic vignettes, finding high accuracy on exams but lower performance on clinical cases compared to GPT-6 Sol.

item.title: [paper] Decompose, Estimate, Select: Coverage-Aware Context Construction for Long-Form RAG
item.description: Coverage-aware retrieval pipeline and grounded self-feedback loop that decompose queries, select documents by maximum-marginal coverage, and refine answers to improve long-form retrieval-augmented generation.

item.title: [paper] Hammering with Vampire in Lean
item.description: Vampire-Hammer links the Vampire automated theorem prover to the Lean interactive theorem prover, successfully solving thousands of previously unproven Mathlib theorems.

item.title: [paper] Textual Response-Aware Guidance for Zero-Shot Adversarial Robustness of Vision-Language Models
item.description: Textual Response-Aware Guidance constrains visual representation drift in vision-language models using pre-trained text encoder responses to improve zero-shot adversarial robustness.

item.title: [paper] Rimuru: Unified Memory Management for Modern LLM Serving via Elastic Expert Offloading
item.description: Rimuru is an LLM serving system that unifies memory management across heterogeneous tensors using elastic expert offloading and a shared page pool.

item.title: [paper] Causal-prior-constrained deep learning for rapid-intensification warning of western North Pacific tropical cyclones
item.description: CausalVisionRI is a causal-prior-constrained deep learning system that integrates multi-modal data and a causal graph to provide early warnings for tropical cyclone rapid intensification.

item.title: [paper] Self-training for cross-centre coronary vessel segmentation in X-ray angiography using pre-contrast frame subtraction
item.description: Self-training method using pseudo-labels from model predictions and frame subtraction to improve cross-centre coronary vessel segmentation in X-ray angiography without extra manual annotation.

item.title: [paper] DolphinRouting: Cluster-Level Binary Routing for Disaggregated LLM Inference Serving
item.description: DolphinRouting is a cluster-level binary routing system for disaggregated LLM inference that uses prompt clustering and offline policy search to reduce latency.

item.title: [paper] Leveraging Recourse and Size Bounds for OnlineKnapsack with Removable Items
item.description: Online algorithm for the knapsack problem with removable items that leverages size bounds and recourse to improve competitive ratios for item selection.

item.title: [paper] Only Accepted Tokens Count: An Energy Accounting of Speculative Decoding Under Latency Targets
item.description: Energy accounting analysis of speculative decoding under latency targets showing how energy savings depend on token acceptance rates and batch sizes.

item.title: [paper] LoRe-MIM: Lost-or-Replaced Masked Image Modeling for Self-Supervised Representation Learning in Whole-Body PET/CT
item.description: LoRe-MIM is a self-supervised masked image modeling framework for whole-body PET/CT scans that uses modality-specific and cross-modal reconstruction to improve disease detection and segmentation tasks.

item.title: [paper] Latent Path Exploration via Potential-Guided Subtrajectory Balance
item.description: SubLAT couples relative answer potential with subtrajectory balance to guide continuous latent reasoning in language models, improving solution coverage on arithmetic and deductive reasoning benchmarks.

item.title: [paper] Latent Prediction Yields Cross-Subject Alignable Representations in Sensory-Evoked fMRI
item.description: A self-supervised joint embedding predictive architecture trains participant-specific encoders on fMRI data alone, yielding aligned representations that enable cross-participant neural decoding without shared stimuli.

item.title: [paper] Neighborhood Elites: Quality-Diversity Search for Uncertainty Quantification in Question Answering
item.description: Neighborhood elites is a quality-diversity search method for question answering that spreads input rewrites across edit types and support explicitness to improve failure detection in large language models.

item.title: [paper] TaskFrame: Connecting Task-Level Planning with Frame-Level Control for Game Agents
item.description: TaskFrame is a hierarchical framework combining a vision-language task planner and a causal Transformer controller to handle high-level task reasoning and low-latency action control for game agents.

item.title: [paper] From MS/MS evidence to adaptive spectroscopic characterization: Reinforcement learning guided by candidate molecular structures
item.description: A structure-informed deep Q-network uses existing tandem mass spectrometry evidence and candidate molecular structures to decide whether further characterization is needed and which measurements to request.

item.title: [paper] Learned Terminal Costs for Short-Horizon Model Predictive Control of Autonomous Trucks in Interactive Highway Traffic
item.description: A hybrid control framework combines a finite-horizon model predictive control model with a pre-trained reinforcement learning terminal cost estimator to achieve safe and efficient navigation for autonomous trucks.

item.title: [paper] When Requirements Interact: Scaling Long-Horizon Coding via Interdependent Specifications
item.description: CodeSpecWeave synthesizes complex coding tasks with rich, interdependent specifications and executable tests, improving the long-horizon software development performance of coding agents through reinforcement learning.

item.title: [paper] Statistical Analysis of Synthetic Data with Verification: A Linear Regression Framework
item.description: A linear regression framework analyzes verified self-training on synthetic data, revealing how verification thresholds, generation noise, and fine-tuning strategies affect prediction risk and model collapse.

item.title: [paper] Confidence-Aware Speed-over-Ground Estimation from Doppler Spectra via Reconstruction-Based Representation Learning
item.description: A confidence-aware estimation approach uses an autoencoder latent space and a dedicated confidence head to predict speed-over-ground and frame-level error bounds from Doppler spectra with high robustness.

item.title: [paper] Conformal Annotation with Randomized Expert Review: Application to Online Cell-Type Labeling
item.description: Conformal Annotation with Randomized Expert Review is a distribution-free framework that uses randomized expert audits to achieve long-run error control for AI-assisted cell-type annotation under distribution shift.

item.title: [paper] Distributional Reward Calibration and Budget-Neutral Credit Assignment for Multimodal RLVR
item.description: TACE is a two-stage advantage and credit estimation method that achieves population-level inter-task moment equity, deterministic tail bounds, and mass-conservation properties for multimodal reinforcement learning.

item.title: [paper] Reaction precedents extend retrosynthetic prediction beyond training coverage
item.description: Inference-time reaction precedents improve retrosynthetic prediction performance across general-purpose and specialized models without requiring task-specific parameter fine-tuning.

item.title: [paper] LLM-guided Planar Loco-Manipulation for Quadruped Robots
item.description: LLM-guided Planar Loco-Manipulation is a framework that combines a language-conditioned task planner with a whole-body pushing policy to enable quadruped robots to navigate and interact with movable obstacles in cluttered environments.

item.title: [paper] EnvOS: Auditing Computer-Use Agents When the World Moves On : Phenomenon-Based Task Construction, Certification, and Evidence-Based Evaluation
item.description: EnvOS is a framework for building and certifying environments that change mid-task to evaluate the robustness of computer-use agents against dynamic software modifications.

item.title: [paper] Judged in Company: In-Context Batching Makes LLM Verdicts Depend on Other Items
item.description: In-context batching causes language models to change their verdicts on independent items based on other items in the prompt, leading to inconsistent grading decisions.

item.title: [paper] ScienceJudge: Pattern Perturbation Augmentation for Sentence-Level Scientific Claim Verification
item.description: ScienceJudge is a scientific claim verification system that uses pattern perturbation augmentation and ensemble inference to detect fine-grained reporting errors in AI-generated paragraphs.

item.title: [paper] Mobilizing the Archive: Bitext Extraction at Scale from Archival Documents for Extremely Low-resource Languages
item.description: An OCR and vision-language model pipeline extracts parallel translation examples from linguistic documentation resources to bootstrap machine translation systems for extremely low-resource languages.

item.title: [paper] EpiAgent: Epistemic Self-Play for LLM Agents
item.description: EpiAgent is a framework that equips language model agents with an explicit epistemic layer and self-play optimization to model beliefs and guide decision-making under incomplete information.

item.title: [paper] DYNAS: A Dynamic Network Penetration Testing Framework Using Deep Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning
item.description: DYNAS is a dynamic network attack simulator and hierarchical reinforcement learning framework that provides controlled evaluation and improved penetration testing performance under non-stationary defensive conditions.

item.title: [paper] Benchmarking color judgment in multimodal LLMs with CIE-computable ground truth
item.description: Benchmark based on the CIE colorimetric framework evaluates multimodal large language models on five color judgment tasks, revealing significant weaknesses in numeric estimation and calibrated color differences.

item.title: [paper] Decision-Level Error Attribution and Depth-Aware Safety Evaluation of Monocular RGB Human Tracking for Autonomous Robot Navigation
item.description: Study of monocular RGB human tracking for autonomous robots uses a Shapley attribution method to separate rule and perception contributions to decision errors, finding that missed detections are the leading cause of missed dangers.

item.title: [paper] Towards Full-Text Scholarly Argument Mining using Entity-Anchored Claim Extraction
item.description: Approach for scholarly argument mining uses scientific entity mentions to extract and structure claims, and trains encoders on a large silver-standard dataset generated by a majority-voting LLM ensemble.

item.title: [paper] Bridging Semantics and Structure: A Theoretically Grounded Framework for Link Prediction on TAGs
item.description: Bridge-LP is a theoretically grounded framework for link prediction on text-attributed graphs that unifies graph neural networks and language models through jumping connections, compressed embeddings, and a cache embedding training strategy.

item.title: [paper] Video Generation Meets Agent Harness: Agentic Video Generation, Agentic World Modeling and Recursive Self-Improvement
item.description: Agent harness framework coordinates tools, memory, and feedback around video models to enable agentic video generation, agentic world modeling, and recursive self-improvement.

item.title: [paper] AdMuse: Skill-Guided Creative Advertising Image Generation
item.description: AdMuse is a skill-guided multi-agent framework that abstracts advertising strategies into reusable creative skills to generate compelling advertisements that faithfully communicate product positioning.

item.title: [paper] Understanding axial attention in TSFMs through single location regression
item.description: Extension of the Single Location Regression framework analyzes the statistical properties and training dynamics of axial attention in time series foundation models, proving that an analytically tractable predictor achieves Bayes optimality.

item.title: [paper] Locating and Closing Information Gaps in Multi-Agent Systems
item.description: SPLICE is a method that locates information gaps in multi-agent workflows by selectively probing and adding edges to deliver missing evidence, improving task scores on web tool use and reasoning benchmarks.

item.title: [paper] Hidden Disparities in Ranking: Category-Aware Fairness via Distributional Stability
item.description: Probabilistic framework for fair ranking in recommender systems models ranking policies as distributions over permutations to satisfy utility parity and category-aware fairness via distributional stability.

item.title: [paper] Beyond CCT: Multi-channel SPD recovery for per-shot camera color correction
item.description: Method for per-shot camera color correction recovers the illuminant spectral power distribution using non-negative least squares against a basis dictionary, reducing angular color error compared to traditional correlated color temperature pipelines.
